semantics.limit_rule: Hard/soft limit semantics are explicit per dimension.
semantics.hard_rule: Hard limit exceed stops/fails or enters explicit bounded recovery policy.
semantics.soft_rule: Soft limit exceed may warn/throttle/deprioritize according to explicit profile.
semantics.semantic_rule: Budget enforcement never returns semantically different data as complete unless partial-result semantics are explicitly requested.
semantics.authority_rule: Budget availability does not grant data or operation access.
semantics.evidence_rule: Consumed resource metrics are derived execution evidence.

invariants.rule: Admission, quotas, concurrency, priority, cancellation and resource budgets may control when/how work executes but never change canonical query/write semantics, data ownership, classification or authorization.
